resources.string: Press Ctrl+Shift+D to save clipboard images (WebP, JPEG, etc.) as PNG and pop up a draggable card

Listens for the Ctrl+Shift+D shortcut to convert any image on the clipboard into a PNG in Downloads and display a floating notification card where you can drag the PNG or right-click/swipe to dismiss. Does not draw on the top status bar so it never conflicts with BentoBar.
